say_intro: 태양 610만 km 앞, 코로나는 200만 도. 그런데 범인은 열이 아니라고요?

why.img: the Sun sliced open like a cake with a quarter wedge cut away, glowing layers inside, a thin wispy glowing halo of gas around it

beats.say: 코로나는 표면보다 1,000만 배 묽어요. 열을 실어 올 알갱이가 적어요.
beats.img: a thin glowing gas shell around a bright sphere cut open like a cake, only a few scattered tiny glowing particles floating inside the shell
beats.label: 듬성듬성 입자

beats.img: a smooth featureless mannequin-like human figure made of clear glass standing in intensely bright white light, skeleton and organs visible inside, the whole body glowing hot in the center
beats.label: 온몸에 빛

beats.say: 게다가 진공이에요. 약 9~11초면 정신을 잃고 혀 위 물이 끓어요.
beats.img: a smooth featureless mannequin-like human head and neck made of clear glass floating in dark space, the brain glowing in the center
beats.label: 뇌

verdict.img: a small space probe hiding behind a thick round heat shield, the shield cut open showing layered carbon foam inside, a giant glowing sun beside it
verdict.label: 열 방패

caption: 태양 코로나 200만 도, 범인은 열이 아니라고? ☀️
